title: Periapical Healing, Event-free Survival, and Associated Factors Following Non-surgical Endodontic Retreatment: An Ambispective Cohort Study
html: Despite favorable outcomes of non-surgical endodontic retreatment (NS-ReTx), treatment decisions for previously treated posterior teeth with apical periodontitis remain inconsistent. This ambispective cohort study evaluated NS-ReTx outcomes in posterior teeth.
